note: A beginner voice week at 15 minutes a day with no instrument needed: bare drills stay at 3 minutes, the longer singing is tunes chosen by pick and chord tones over chords the app plays, Do Mi Sol returns every day in a new form, and an ear game sits between singing blocks.

plan.title: Week 1: Do Mi Sol, in tune
plan.summary: Sing in tune over a drone, skip through Do Mi Sol, and use it in tunes and over chords.

exercises.title: Long Do
exercises.focus: One breath, Do over a drone in C

sections.text: A steady long note warms up the breath and the ear together.
Press Play on the drone. Breathe in low for four clicks, sing {{1}} on "ah" for eight, rest four. Repeat, aiming for a flat line on the staff.

exercises.title: Steps or skips?
exercises.focus: Major 2nd vs major 3rd by ear

sections.text: Hearing whether a melody steps or skips is the first thing your ear needs to sing it back.
Name each interval: a major 2nd (Do to Re, a step) or a major 3rd (Do to Mi, a skip). Done at eight right in a row.

exercises.title: Do Mi Sol over the drone
exercises.focus: Do Mi Sol in C, up and back

sections.text: Do, Mi and Sol are the notes of the home chord, so most tunes lean on them.
Press Play on the drone. Sing {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} {{3}} {{1}} on "la", four counts each. Done when each note settles without sliding.

exercises.title: Two step tunes
exercises.focus: Easy Do Re Mi tunes in C

sections.text: Short tunes turn the notes into music you remember.
First tune
Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. Two clean takes.
Second tune
Another tune on the same three notes. This time look at it and sing it before you hear it, then press Play to check.

exercises.title: Hum and open
exercises.focus: Hum to "ah" on Do and Sol in D

sections.text: Humming finds the pitch gently before the full voice.
Press Play on the drone. Hum {{1}} for four counts and open to "ah" for four. Then the same on {{5}}.

exercises.title: A skipping tune
exercises.focus: An easy Do Mi Sol tune in D

sections.text: A tune that skips trains the jumps you drilled on day 1.
Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. When it is clean, sing it once from memory.

exercises.title: 3rd or 5th?
exercises.focus: Major 3rd vs perfect 5th by ear

sections.text: Do to Mi and Do to Sol are the two skips of the week; telling them apart by ear makes them easy to sing.
Name each interval: a major 3rd (Do to Mi) or a perfect 5th (Do to Sol). Sing it back before you answer.

exercises.title: Do and Sol over chords
exercises.focus: Do over D, Sol over A

sections.text: Singing a chord's note while the chord sounds is how a voice fits into music.
Press Play: the chords D and A take turns, one bar each. Sing {{1}} (D) over the D chord and {{5}} (A) over the A chord. Then try {{3}} (F♯) over D.

exercises.title: Ten-count Do
exercises.focus: Do for ten clicks in G

sections.text: A little longer each day builds breath without strain.
Breathe in for four clicks, sing {{1}} on "oo" for ten. Rest and repeat. Stop before you run out; the end of the note should be as steady as the start.

exercises.title: 5th or 6th?
exercises.focus: Perfect 5th vs major 6th by ear

sections.text: La sits one step above Sol; hearing the difference prepares today's tune.
Name each interval: a perfect 5th (Do to Sol) or a major 6th (Do to La). Done at eight right in a row.

exercises.title: Sol La Sol
exercises.focus: An easy La tune in G

sections.text: Sol La Sol is the lift at the top of many children's songs.
Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. Notice it lands on Do through Mi: the week's skip, downward.

exercises.title: Over G and D
exercises.focus: Do, Mi and Sol over I and V in G

sections.text: Choosing which chord note to sing is the very first step of making up a melody.
Press Play. Over the G chord sing {{1}} or {{3}}; over the D chord sing {{5}}. Change your choice every time round.

exercises.title: Siren to Sol
exercises.focus: Glide Do to Sol and back in F

sections.text: A slow glide loosens the voice and shows on the staff where your pitch goes between notes.
On "ng", glide slowly from {{1}} up to {{5}} and back, five times. Then sing the two notes cleanly without the glide.

exercises.title: A tune under Do
exercises.focus: An easy tune that dips below Do, in F

sections.text: Tunes often dip under Do before coming home; this one does.
Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. Keep the low notes light, not pushed down.

exercises.title: Up or down?
exercises.focus: Major 3rd and perfect 5th, falling

sections.text: Skips come downwards too, and they feel different.
The same two intervals as day 2, now falling: name a major 3rd (Mi to Do) or a perfect 5th (Sol to Do).

exercises.title: Over F, B♭ and C
exercises.focus: Chord notes over I-IV-V in F

sections.text: Three chords means three homes for the voice to find.
Press Play. Sing {{1}} (F) over F, {{4}} (B♭) over B♭, {{5}} (C) over C, holding each for the whole bar. Then try {{3}} (A) over F instead.

days.theme: Do Mi Sol in a new key

exercises.title: Long Sol
exercises.focus: Sol for eight clicks in A

sections.text: Holding a note that is not Do tests your pitch against the drone.
Press Play on the drone. Sing {{5}} on "ah" for eight clicks; it should sound settled, not rubbing. Then {{1}} for eight.

exercises.title: Skips, mixed
exercises.focus: Major 2nd, major 3rd, perfect 5th by ear

sections.text: Mixing the week's intervals checks that your ear knows each one on its own.
Name each: a major 2nd, a major 3rd or a perfect 5th. Done at ten right in a row.

exercises.title: Do Mi Sol in A
exercises.focus: Do Mi Sol up, down and skipped, over a drone in A

sections.text: A new key moves every note, but the pattern stays the same in your ear.
Sing {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} up and back, then {{5}} {{1}} {{3}} {{1}}, four counts each.

exercises.title: A harder skipping tune
exercises.focus: A medium Do Mi Sol tune in A

sections.text: A longer tune puts the skips inside phrases you have to remember.
Learn it
Press Play and sing along softly, then sing it with the mic phrase by phrase.
Sing it through
The whole tune with the mic, without hearing it first. Done at two clean takes.

exercises.title: Do Re Mi Re Do
exercises.focus: Steps over a drone in C

sections.text: Steps are the other half of every melody.
Press Play on the drone. Sing {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} {{2}} {{1}} on "la", two counts each, five times.

exercises.title: A medium step tune
exercises.focus: A medium Do Re Mi tune in C

sections.text: A tune that starts away from Do trains you to hear where home is.
Look first and sing it from the staff, then press Play to check. Sing it with the mic until a take is clean.

exercises.title: Hear and sing back
exercises.focus: Major 3rd and perfect 5th, sung before answering

sections.text: Singing an interval back before naming it ties the ear to the voice.
For each question, sing both notes back first, then name it: a major 3rd or a perfect 5th.

exercises.title: A tune in 3rds
exercises.focus: An easy tune climbing in 3rds, in C

sections.text: Climbing in 3rds mixes steps and skips in one phrase, which is how real melodies move.
Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. Then sing it a second time a little louder, keeping it in tune.

exercises.title: Twelve-count Do
exercises.focus: Do for twelve clicks in D

sections.text: Day 1 was eight clicks; twelve shows the week's progress.
Breathe in for four clicks, sing {{1}} for twelve. Twice, with a rest between.

exercises.title: A Sol tune
exercises.focus: An easy tune down from Sol, in D

sections.text: A new tune on day 7, sung first time from the staff, shows how far your reading has come.
Sing it from the staff before hearing it, then press Play to check. Then one clean take with the mic.

exercises.title: The week's intervals
exercises.focus: Major 2nd, major 3rd, perfect 5th, major 6th

sections.text: All four of the week's intervals together: a check of your ear.
Name each: major 2nd, major 3rd, perfect 5th or major 6th. Count how many of twenty you get.

exercises.title: Your own line over chords
exercises.focus: Do Mi Sol over I-IV-V-I in D

sections.text: Making up a line from the notes you know is the reward for the week.
Press Play. Over each chord, sing any of {{1}} {{3}} {{5}}, moving by step or skip; over the A chord lean on {{5}}, which is its root. Record one pass and listen back.
